name: block-breadcrumbs
use: The path from the home page to this page, above the first screen, with BreadcrumbList structured data for search.
avoid: The home page itself; more than one per page.
props: { kind: 'block-breadcrumbs'; items: { label: string; href?: string }[] }

cases.title: Path to a page of documentation
cases.why: The reader sees where the page sits and goes one level up.

docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-breadcrumbs. In a page: { "kind": "block-breadcrumbs", "items": [ { "label": "Home", "href": "/en" }, { "label": "This page" } ] } first.
